text:
maya: quick flag  fncall returns 200 but validator marks response REJECT (reason: top_level_array). Happening on canary-eu. console card just says 'validation failed' and no breakdown.
liam: saw two paged alerts. we need a short hint in telemetry so rollouts can correlate.
nina: example: `{"tool":"catalog_search","resp":[{"sku":"A1"}]}` validator expects `resp` to be object. adapter sometimes wraps.
omar: router idea: per-route `shape_coercion` opt-in. if enabled, before hard-validate we run a coercion transform that converts single-item arrays to objects for configured keys and tag telemetry `coercion_applied=true`.
maya: careful about masking real regressions. coercion should increment a separate metric and only be auto-enabled for non-critical routes or in canary.
liam: telemetry change: emit `validator_hint` enum (top_level_array, missing_key, type_mismatch), `coercion_applied` bool, and optional `sample_blob_key` when sampled. sample access gated by ops ACL.
nina: UI: show hint + clickable "view sample (ops)". also add filter on rollouts to highlight variants with >X top_level_array rejects.
omar: ops-bot: created ticket ENGPLAT-1377 for telemetry+router+ui work.
ops-bot: scheduled canary: canary-eu @ 04:30 UTC with shape_coercion=canary(0.5%).
maya: action items: omar add router PR, liam schema PR, nina UI patch, and we'll reconvene after canary metrics.
